name: Since Us
tagline: Count your time together and never miss an anniversary or special day.
description:
How long have you been together? Since Us shows you at a glance, with your favorite photo.

Your time together: days, weeks, months and hours since you got together. Live mode even counts every second.

Never miss a special day: reminders for monthly and yearly anniversaries, round numbers like 100 or 500 days and fun numbers like 222, at a time you choose.

Your moments: keep your first date, first kiss or first trip with a note and a photo, and get reminded every year.

Widgets: a love card with your names and days together, or a compact counter in your phone's colors.

Private: no account, no ads, no tracking. All data stays on your phone. English and German. Free and open source (GPL-3.0).
